title: OK....but cats look forward to it!
text: I gave 3 stars because I got the multi cat box it was smaller then expected. I have 3 cats so 1 pack of treats will only last about a week. Toys were sports themed which is cute. The cats loved all the toys bough it will keep them busy for sure I’ll do an unboxing with them because they know when hat box is here lol. So the first box was OK. Hope the next is better!
label: neutral
